//: TRUSTING preset (guide/10-permissions.md). Standard + edits and new files INSIDE the working directory without a prompt (git is the backup there). Everything outside the repo, all VC state changes, deletes, pushes, deploys and service bootstraps still prompt — no Bash allow rules, because a prefix rule allows every option too (sed -i, git branch -D, find -delete). For an interactive workstation where you're present.
//invariant: Even 'trusting' NEVER auto-approves: git push, git reset/clean, deletes of tracked paths, deploys, remote-artifact creation, or service bootstraps. Presets trade friction on LOW-RISK actions only — never on the dangerous set. A wrong auto-approved push outweighs the saved prompts.
//dangerousMode: If your CLI has a skip-all-prompts / dangerous mode flag, understand exactly what it disables before enabling, prefer it only on a workstation where you're present, and document the choice. Do not enable it on a server.
